title: Utility Enrollment Processing and Contract End Dates, Small Business Electricity Supply
content:
After a Small Business Electricity Supply enrollment is submitted, the utility either accepts it, its confirmation letter date being recorded as the utility confirmation date, or rejects it with one of the utility rejection reasons. Supply begins on the switch meter read date, which becomes the service start date. For a plan with a term above 0 months, the contract end date is the day before the same calendar day the term's months after the service start date; when that calendar day does not exist in the target month, the last day of that month is used before the day is subtracted. A month-to-month plan has an empty contract end date. A rejected enrollment ends permanently; a new enrollment creates a new agreement priced on its own enrollment date.

## Outcomes of a submitted enrollment

| Utility outcome | What the agreement record shows |
|---|---|
| Accepted | the utility confirmation date (the date printed on the confirmation letter) |
| Switch meter read reached | the service start date (the switch meter read date) and, for a plan with a term, the contract end date |
| Rejected | the utility's rejection reason; the enrollment ends permanently |

## Contract end date, worked on hypothetical dates

| Service start date | Term | Same calendar day, term's months later | Contract end date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2026 | 12 months | 15 March 2027 | 14 March 2027 |
| 1 July 2025 | 36 months | 1 July 2028 | 30 June 2028 |
| 29 February 2024 | 12 months | 29 February 2025 does not exist; last day of February 2025 is 28 February | 27 February 2025 |
| 10 May 2026 | month-to-month | not applicable | empty |

## After a rejection

The rejected agreement is not revived. If the business enrolls the site again, the new enrollment creates a new agreement, and that agreement is priced on its own enrollment date.
